source_scope: Scheduled-task context and retrievable prior summaries, independently cross-checked against linked author/vendor/public-repository pages on 2026-10-20. No complete per-run task output archive or frozen source bytes accessible.
coverage_limits: Automation scheduling metadata is not the same as a saved run result; missed runs are not reconstructed.
Retrieved prior conversation summaries are not a complete archive of notifications, raw inputs, or searches.
Author and vendor claims have not been independently benchmarked or reproduced in this intake.
Live source content was inspected at URLs but source bytes were not content-addressed, and chronological freshness after the observation date is not asserted.

All candidate mechanisms appear representable within provisional v0.5's declared source, semantic interpretation, graph, provenance, validation, confidence, or governance extension interfaces; this is a preliminary mapping, not a proof of saturation.
No automatic change to FAR-CORE, FARA, EFR, v0.5, project status, accepted evidence, feature scope, or benchmark results.

entries.title: No Hindsight for LLM Fact-Checkers: Measuring Leakage Channels in Misinformation Detection
entries.source_reported_observation: Paper reports a 6.3-point AVeriTeC zero-shot lift when post-claim evidence is permitted; it separates parametric memorization from retrieval hindsight.
entries.inference_limit: Point-in-time source admissibility and memorization leakage are distinct; source timestamps alone do not rule out parametric hindsight.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Time-cutoff paired benchmark with publication-index freeze and model-memory probe.

entries.title: Rethinking Inline Citation Verification in Scholarly Communication
entries.source_reported_observation: Mixed-methods study of 12 reviewer interviews and a 203-reviewer survey about citation verification practices.
entries.inference_limit: Reviewer preferences and citation types differ; this does not measure FAR's own citation fidelity.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Citation-type-stratified manual review and citation-to-passage support error rates.

entries.title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
entries.source_reported_observation: Position and formal model require explicit policy, scope, evidence records, provenance, decision rules, and observation coverage; stated impossibility results are model-conditional.
entries.inference_limit: Formal guarantees do not transfer automatically to FAR production deployments or external actor records.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Build six auditable-policy fixtures: missing independent observer, argument mismatch, incomplete action record.

entries.title: What Counts as Evidence? Epistemic Cue Utilization in Large Language Models
entries.source_reported_observation: Controlled study reports 500 scenarios and 13 models; source reliability recognition can diverge from actual reliance during judgments.
entries.inference_limit: Citation existence and stated source-quality ratings cannot establish how a model used evidence.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Counterfactual source-history/order swaps with fixed evidence and measured verdict sensitivity.

entries.title: Same Claim, Different Interpretations: How LLM Agents Resolve Ambiguity in Scientific Claims
entries.source_reported_observation: Claim Cards expose nine interpretation fields; authors report 900 runs on 60 labeled scientific claims and deliberate interpretation edits changing verdicts.
entries.inference_limit: Observed influence is specific to tested agents and scientific claims; does not show semantic correctness of FAR's mappings.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Freeze interpretation cards; mutate one quantifier or threshold; compare evidence, formalization and final verdict.

entries.title: Argument Graph Uncertainty: Quantifying Uncertainty from the Logical Structure of Reasoning Chains
entries.source_reported_observation: NLI-based argument graph scores feed a Dirichlet uncertainty estimate on multiple-choice benchmarks; authors report gains over sampled baselines.
entries.inference_limit: Graph coherence estimates uncertainty, not sound entailment or true source propositions.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Compare graph-based confidence with independent countermodel checker on known-invalid valid-premise arguments.

entries.title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
entries.source_reported_observation: Decomposes review comments into explicit premises and checks each against a paper; authors report accuracy-cost/latency improvements against LLM baselines.
entries.inference_limit: Premise factuality is not the same obligation as premise-to-conclusion entailment.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Hold correct premises fixed and introduce invalid inference; score detection separately from premise retrieval.

entries.title: Approve What, Exactly? Effect Binding and Trusted Rendering for Agent Step-Up Authorization
entries.source_reported_observation: Authors describe 12 approval-path attacks, evaluations of agent runtimes and conditional Tamarin formal guarantees for an effect-bound approval gateway.
entries.inference_limit: Device-bound authorization under model assumptions does not establish independent audit completeness in FAR.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Mutate approved recipient/amount after signed effect descriptor; require authorization and execution-record rejection.

entries.title: Stamp AI benchmark disclosure (Fact Engineering)
entries.source_reported_observation: Vendor reports AVeriTeC evaluation of 2,123 claims: 89.0% alignment on 1,808 settled labels, 96.6% correct within a high-confidence subset, 74.7% without an existing fact-check in retrieved evidence.
entries.inference_limit: Self-reported dataset-label agreement is not independent reproduction, real-world downstream accuracy, or premise-to-conclusion entailment.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Reproduce vendor's label mapping on frozen matched claims; stratify fact-check retrieval contamination, mixed labels, and abstentions.

entries.title: Minerval public claim-graph implementation
entries.source_reported_observation: Public source describes canonical claims, decomposition, assessment history, provenance, a public read API, an extension and MCP access.
entries.inference_limit: Public code and documented features demonstrate substantial conceptual overlap, not verified service reliability, customer adoption, or correctness.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Matched document-to-claim-graph trial measuring identity stability, source support, counterexamples and cost vs FAR.

entries.title: Noesis local-first evidence knowledge engine
entries.source_reported_observation: Public source describes versioned cited evidence, historical replay, MCP, REST, and CLI surfaces.
entries.inference_limit: A source repository and architecture description do not demonstrate actual correctness or sustained deployment.
entries.single_falsification_or_comparison_test: Independent offline replay with changed sources and time-cutoff invalidation comparison.
